platform: macOS 27.2 arm64; IntelliJ Platform 2026.1.4; bundled gopls 0.24.0

fixture.purpose: The malformed but parseable source forces import grouping, blank-line, brace and whitespace changes while preserving semantics.

steps: The file was written to the isolated tracked fixture and opened in the native Go editor.
The native Reformat Code action was invoked with Shift+Command+L.
The editor changed to canonical gofmt layout with a grouped import block and normalized function body.
A single Command+Z restored the exact original malformed bytes.
boundary: This verifies one native formatting transaction and one Undo in a parseable single Go file. Save-triggered formatting, multi-file scope, cursor preservation, invalid syntax, cancellation and cross-platform behavior remain separate checks.
